input.question: When was the National Indian Association formed?

documents.text: National Indian Association The National Indian Association was formed in Bristol by Mary Carpenter. The London branch was formed the following year. After the death of Mary Carpenter, Elizabeth Adelaide Manning (E. A. Manning) became secretary and the organisation moved to London where its activities became synonymous with Manning. The "National Indian Association in Aid of Social Progress in India" was formed by Mary Carpenter in 1870 in Bristol. Its first objective was to improve education for Indian women.
